name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add LTX-Video’s 1080p motion model to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It cuts motion blur by 15-20% in fast pans and cuts, which directly lifts EXCAVA’s usable frame quality without extra compute. The trade-off is a 3-5% speed drop in motion-heavy scenes, but the clarity gain outweighs the latency for most power users.

name: Torque
text: LTX-Video’s motion model won’t lift EXCAVA’s 1080p ceiling—it just trades blur for artifacting in high-motion shots, masking the core resolution limit. The real play is swapping to a 4K-native model like Pika 1.0 or LTX-Video’s 4K variant; if those fail, test Runway Gen-4’s upscaler—it adds 0.7% usable clarity at 2x the cost but no extra latency. Run a blind A/B on 100 clips: if the 4K upscale scores >5% higher on sharpness without new artifacts, it’s the call.
